title: Quiz: Working With APIs in Python: Reading Public Data
description: Test your understanding of consuming REST APIs with Requests, from status codes and JSON to query parameters, authentication, and rate limits.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Working With APIs in Python: Reading Public Data . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how requests and responses work, what common status codes mean, how to read JSON data, how to filter results with query parameters, and how to authenticate with an API key.
takeaways: Once you know these basics, you can start pulling data from almost any public API into your own projects. [ Improve Your Python With 🐍 Python Tricks 💌 – Get a short & sweet Python Trick delivered to your inbox every couple of days. >> Click here to learn more and see examples ]

By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how requests and responses work, what common status codes mean, how to read JSON data, how to filter results with query parameters, and how to authenticate with an API key.
You’ll also check how to go easy on an API’s servers with pagination and by respecting rate limits.
